vc_club_night.text: The club has a line around the block and a bass line you can feel in your teeth. Your friends are already inside.

outcomes.dance_epic: The DJ reads your mind. You leave at dawn, hoarse and glowing.
outcomes.dance_ankle: Someone stomps your foot and you hobble home on one heel.

vc_bouncer.text: The bouncer looks at your shoes, then your face, then shakes his head. "Not tonight."

outcomes.charm_in: He smirks, unhooks the rope and mutters "behave."
outcomes.charm_no: Your charm bounces off him like rain off a truck.
outcomes.argue_thrown: You get a shove and a lecture on your dress code, mostly the shove.
outcomes.argue_bribe: A folded bill ends the debate. You are in, and $100 poorer.

vc_bar_fight.text: A guy knocks your drink out of your hand and does not apologize. His friends are drifting closer.

outcomes.punch_win: You land one clean and the other guy folds. Your knuckles will remember this.
outcomes.punch_beat: You wake up with a split lip, a black eye, and a very personal ER bill.
outcomes.punch_arrest: Police arrive. You spend the night in a cell and a morning in front of a judge.
outcomes.punch_dead: A broken bottle changes everything. It is over before the ambulance turns the corner.
outcomes.separate_hero: The two goons shake hands. Someone buys you a drink.
outcomes.separate_elbow: You take an elbow to the eye for your trouble.

vc_drunk_text_ex.text: It is 2am, the bar is closing, and your thumb hovers over {{name}}'s name. You wrote a really good paragraph.

choices.friend: Give your phone to a friend

outcomes.send_warm: {{name}} replies with a heart. The conversation is tender, brief, and a terrible idea.
outcomes.send_left: Read at 2:03. No reply. You stare at the ceiling until morning.
outcomes.send_blocked: The message will not deliver. {{name}} blocked you at some point and you never noticed.

vc_wake_up_strange.text: You wake up on a couch you have never seen before. There is a traffic cone on the coffee table. Your phone is at 3%.

choices.uber: Call a ride and go home

outcomes.look_kind: A stranger hands you toast and a glass of water. Nobody judges. You make a friend.
outcomes.look_robbed: Your wallet and your left shoe are gone. Both a mystery.
outcomes.look_roof: You are on a rooftop with six strangers, a speaker, and the best view in town.

vc_bartender_likes.text: The bartender remembers your drink, laughs at your jokes, and keeps refilling your water for free. Interesting.

outcomes.ask_yes: They slide their number across the bar with the receipt. It starts with a drink and ends with a date.
outcomes.ask_no: They smile politely. "I don't date customers." You tip well anyway.

vc_afterparty.text: The club lights come on. A stranger waves a house key. "Penthouse. Fifteen minutes. Bring ice."

outcomes.stay_legend: Someone plays piano at 5am. You will talk about this night for years.
outcomes.stay_mess: You break a lamp that was not yours. Strangers split the cost. You still owe an apology.
outcomes.stay_hook: You talk on the balcony until the sun comes up. Their number is already in your phone.

vc_karaoke.text: It is karaoke night, you are three drinks deep, and the host calls your name. Somebody signed you up.

outcomes.sing_star: You hit the high note by accident. The room loses its mind.
outcomes.sing_cringe: Nobody told you the lyrics were that long. Someone films it.

vc_bar_tab.text: The bill lands: $780. Twelve people, one card, and a creative round of tequila nobody remembers ordering.

outcomes.dash_clean: You vanish into the night like a ghost. A free evening, with a small knot of guilt.
outcomes.dash_caught: The owner is faster than he looks. You pay the tab, a fine, and a lot of dignity.

vc_dj_booth.text: You squeeze up to the DJ booth. The playlist is great. The one song you want is not on it.

outcomes.request_drop: The DJ nods and plays it. The crowd explodes. You feel briefly famous.
outcomes.request_nope: "This isn't a jukebox." You get a look worse than the bouncer's.

vc_walk_home.text: It is 3am, the buses stopped an hour ago, and your shoes have given up. Home is forty minutes away.

choices.friend: Share a ride with a friend

outcomes.walk_peace: The city is empty and soft. You get home with a kebab and a clear head.
outcomes.walk_trouble: Two guys shake you down in an alley. You lose your phone and some faith in the night.

vc_dive_regular.text: The dive bar on the corner has sticky floors, a broken jukebox, and cheaper drinks than anywhere else. People already nod at you.

outcomes.bet_win: You clear the table and a retired plumber named Walt calls you "kid" with respect.
outcomes.bet_lose: You lose by three balls and $80 on a bet you made while overconfident.

vc_peer_shots.text: Somebody is lining up shots and your name keeps coming up in the chant. The circle looks at you.

outcomes.take_fun: One shot becomes four. Everyone is your best friend for an hour.
outcomes.take_sick: The fourth one lands badly. You meet the bathroom floor.

vc_bender.text: The week was brutal and the weekend is a blank door. Your phone lights up with a group chat called "no rules."

outcomes.go_wild: Three days of the best and worst decisions. You surface thinner and poorer.
outcomes.go_addict: On day four you realise you can't stop. It is not funny anymore.
outcomes.go_bounce: You pay for it with a week of hangovers, but you come out laughing.

vc_dui.text: You have had far more than you planned. The car is close, the night is quiet, and a voice says you are fine.

choices.sleep: Sleep it off in the car

outcomes.drive_fine: You make it home on pure luck. You know it was luck.
outcomes.drive_stop: Red and blue lights. A breathalyser. Fines, a suspended licence and a lawyer.
outcomes.drive_crash: You scrape a lamppost and the car is totalled. You walk away, shaking, to a world of paperwork.

vc_intervention.text: {{name}} and two other friends are sitting in your living room with a plate of cookies and a letter. This is not a surprise party.

outcomes.listen_clean: You cry in {{name}}'s kitchen and agree to get help. It is the first honest night in years.
outcomes.listen_relapse: You nod and promise things. The urge is louder than the promise.

vc_relapse.text: It is Thursday and you are bored, stressed and in front of an open cupboard. The old habit knows exactly where to find you.

outcomes.call_saved: Your phone call lasts an hour. The craving passes. Barely.
outcomes.call_voicemail: Straight to voicemail. You sit on the edge of the bed and wait it out alone.

vc_get_clean.text: You looked at yourself in the bathroom mirror and did not recognise the person. A leaflet for a clinic has been on your fridge for a month.

outcomes.rehab_works: Six weeks of group chairs and bad coffee. You come out lighter and sharper.
outcomes.rehab_slip: You finish the program but the road is longer than the brochure said.
outcomes.cold_pass: Ten days of shaking, sweating and clock watching. Then, slowly, you feel human.
outcomes.cold_fail: On day three you give up and the shame is worse than the symptoms.

vc_pills_party.text: A friend of a friend opens his palm. Four little pills. "Trust me, it's clean." Everyone nods.

outcomes.take_float: The room turns gold and everyone is beautiful. The comedown is a different story.
outcomes.take_hospital: You black out and wake up in the ER with an IV. The nurse is not impressed.
outcomes.take_dead: It was not what the guy said it was. The music keeps playing.
outcomes.take_hooked: You chase the feeling again and again. By the new year, you need it.

vc_hangover_work.text: Your alarm sounds like a jackhammer. Last night's decisions are loud in your skull and there is a 9:30 meeting.

outcomes.push_okay: Coffee and sunglasses. Nobody smells the vodka. You nap in the stairwell.
outcomes.push_caught: You mix up two clients and your boss sniffs the air for a long second.

vc_edible_festival.text: The festival sun is cooking you. A woman selling gummy bears out of a cooler says they are "special."

outcomes.eat_chill: The stage turns to jelly and the sunset lasts four hours. Best nap of your life.
outcomes.eat_paranoid: Two hours later you are convinced the security guard is your dad. He is not.

vc_dry_month.text: A coworker challenges you to a month off alcohol. Your liver files a motion to support.

outcomes.commit_good: You sleep, think, and save money. You also bore your friends senseless.
outcomes.commit_crack: Day nineteen, a friend's birthday. You manage a heroic nine hours of restraint.

vc_one_night.text: The conversation has been electric all night. They lean in close and whisper an address and a number.

outcomes.go_great: The night is fun, uncomplicated and honest. You part with a smile.
outcomes.go_awkward: Their cat watches you the whole time. You forget their name by morning.
outcomes.go_std: A week later something burns. The clinic visit is humbling.

vc_fwb.text: After one too many, {{name}} says it out loud: "We'd be so good at this, no strings." You both laugh. Then neither of you does.

outcomes.agree_easy: No labels, no drama, great timing. For a few months it works beautifully.
outcomes.agree_feelings: Someone catches feelings. It is you. It is always you.

vc_partner_jealous.text: {{name}} has gone quiet at dinner. Eventually: "Who is Dani?" Dani is a barista. You think.

outcomes.reassure_calm: You hold their hand and tell the truth. The storm passes.
outcomes.reassure_fight: It turns into a fight about everything since 2019.

vc_pregnancy_scare.text: Your period is late. Or you counted wrong. Or the one you slept with did. The bathroom shelf has a fresh test, and no one else knows.

outcomes.test_neg: One line. You laugh like a lunatic and order pizza.
outcomes.test_pos: Two lines. You sit very still. This is a conversation for tomorrow.

vc_ex_wants_back.text: {{name}} shows up at your door with flowers and a speech. It is a good speech. You have heard half of it before.

outcomes.accept_happy: This time you both communicate like adults. For about three weeks.
outcomes.accept_same: Same fights, new apartment. You remember exactly why you broke up.

vc_caught_cheating.text: {{name}} found the thread. The one with the winks. They are sitting calmly, which is worse than shouting.

outcomes.lie_fine: The lie holds. You hate yourself a little extra today.
outcomes.lie_exposed: {{name}} has screenshots. The relationship is over before dessert.

vc_catfish.text: The dating app match has great photos, great jokes and a weird habit of dodging video calls.

outcomes.meet_cute: They look nothing like the photos, and somehow that's a good thing.
outcomes.meet_scam: They ask for "a loan, just until Friday." Friday never comes.
outcomes.meet_bad: Awkward is not the word. You split the check and leave.

vc_clinic_test.text: The nurse reads your results with an expression you can't read. She says: "Sit down."

outcomes.treat_cured: Antibiotics, a lecture, and a tiny bandage on your pride. You're cleared.
outcomes.treat_stubborn: The first round does little. You go back, still embarrassed, and finish it.

vc_wrong_chat.text: You send a very detailed message about last night to what you thought was your best friend. It was the family group.

choices.phone: Throw the phone in the sea

outcomes.delete_fast: You delete it in time. Mom is "typing..." for six minutes and then stops.
outcomes.delete_late: It was already seen by three aunts and the neighbour. Family dinner will be great.

vc_morning_after.text: Morning light on someone else's wall. They're already awake, smiling at you with the smug gentleness of a person who slept well.

outcomes.stay_sweet: They make eggs. You talk about everything. Something starts.
outcomes.stay_weird: Their roommate walks in and gives you a very long look.

vc_mar_boredom.text: You and {{name}} now say "fine" to every question. The couch has two dents in it. Something has to give.

outcomes.date_spark: Dinner, a dumb movie, a long walk. {{name}} laughs the way they did in the beginning.
outcomes.date_flat: You both check your phones between courses. The tiramisu is the best part.

vc_mar_open_prop.text: {{name}} sets down their fork. "Hear me out. Open marriage. Honestly." You look for the hidden camera.

outcomes.agree_works: Rules, check-ins and honest talk. Surprisingly, it works.
outcomes.agree_jealous: First week is exciting. By the fourth you are doing the dishes with murderous energy.

vc_mar_found_text.text: A message pops up on {{name}}'s phone while it's charging: "Last night was incredible. Same time next week?"

outcomes.ask_innocent: It was a surprise-party planner. You owe them an apology and a very nice dinner.
outcomes.ask_guilty: {{name}} goes pale. You know. You both know.

vc_mar_therapy.text: {{name}} drops a pamphlet on the table. "Couples therapy. Tuesday. I already booked." It is not a question.

outcomes.commit_better: The therapist says "I hear you" eleven times. It works anyway.
outcomes.commit_split: Week six, the truth comes out. It's ugly, but at least it is out.
outcomes.commit_meh: Nothing changes, but you learn the therapist's dog is called Noodle.

vc_mar_wild_anniv.text: Anniversary night. {{name}} wants "something unforgettable." You have one night and an open credit line.

outcomes.wild_legend: Champagne, a hot tub, a regrettable dance routine. You are twenty-five again.
outcomes.wild_mess: A noise complaint, a broken glass table, and a stolen bathrobe. {{name}} loves it anyway.

vc_mar_secret_card.text: You have a credit card {{name}} does not know about. The bill has finally gotten big enough to have a personality.

outcomes.hide_clear: You pay it off over the year, quietly, and tell no one.
outcomes.hide_found: {{name}} finds the pile in the garage. The conversation is long and cold.

vc_mar_tempted.text: A coworker has been brushing your arm, laughing a beat too long and texting after hours. The signals are getting loud.

outcomes.flirt_harmless: It is harmless. It is also a little not.
outcomes.flirt_spiral: One drink becomes a hotel room. The guilt arrives before the sunrise.

vc_mar_vegas.text: {{name}} found a flight deal and a chapel with a neon sign. "Let's do it again. Properly stupid this time."

outcomes.vows_fun: An impersonator officiates. You laugh through the whole thing and cry at the end.
outcomes.vows_cheap: The chapel was tacky, the hotel was worse, and the bill was larger than the vows.

vc_tattoo_ex.text: You are at the tattoo parlour at midnight with a fresh bottle of confidence. The design: your ex's name in cursive.

outcomes.do_love: It looks sharp. You tell yourself that this time is different.
outcomes.do_regret: Six months later you pay a fortune to turn it into a vaguely shaped rose.

vc_three_am_buy.text: It is 3am. You are on your seventh tab of a site that sells inflatable kayaks and handmade ceramic crocodiles.

outcomes.return_ok: You return it. The restocking fee stings, but you keep the dignity.
outcomes.return_stuck: Final sale. The espresso-machine-shaped canoe is yours forever.

vc_pyramid_pitch.text: {{name}} invites you to a "business opportunity" with free coffee, a man in a vest, and a lot of talk about being your own boss.

outcomes.join_win: You get lucky and flip it before the whole thing collapses. You never tell anyone.
outcomes.join_lose: The "starter kit" is thirty protein bars and a lanyard. {{name}} stops answering.

vc_fake_id_casino.text: Tonight the casino is playing a song only you can hear. The doorman wants ID, and the card in your wallet is a very good fake.

outcomes.try_in: The doorman squints, shrugs, and waves you in. You lose $300 at roulette.
outcomes.try_busted: Security calls the police. Fake ID is a felony and you suddenly remember that.

vc_bet_cant_pay.text: You bet on a "sure thing" and lost $3,000 to a man who writes IOUs on napkins. You have until Friday.

outcomes.stall_ok: You negotiate a payment plan with a man named Gary. Gary will remember you.
outcomes.stall_beat: Gary's friends find you at the parking lot. They explain interest rates.

vc_sell_plasma.text: Rent is due and the account says $42. A flyer says: "Earn $300 a month. Just give a little."

outcomes.sell_ok: Twenty-five bucks a visit, free cookies, and a chair that smells like iodine.
outcomes.sell_faint: You faint on the way out. The nurse sighs and hands you a juice.

vc_sub_site.text: A friend shows you their income from a subscription site where people pay for exclusive adult content. Your rent is looming.

outcomes.start_boom: The subscribers pour in. You make more in a month than your last job paid in a quarter.
outcomes.start_slow: A trickle of subscribers, a lot of work, and a good camera you now own.
outcomes.start_family: Your cousin finds you. The family group chat goes silent for a week, then loud.

vc_drunk_wedding.text: You are four drinks in, in a city you do not live in, and a chapel is lit up like a Christmas tree. A stranger says: "Why not?"

outcomes.marry_annul: The annulment costs more than the dress. You meet for coffee, once, to laugh.
outcomes.marry_love: You wake up next to a stranger who turns out to be good. Against all odds.
outcomes.marry_mess: The chapel was a scam. The "officiant" is a guy named Todd. You're not married and you're poorer.

vc_loan_shark.text: Your funds are thin and a man in a tracksuit offers cash, no paperwork, no questions. His smile is a little too white.

outcomes.borrow_ok: You pay it back with a ridiculous rate and a tight smile.
outcomes.borrow_trouble: Collections get physical. You pay, bleed and learn a lot about compound interest.

vc_viral_prank.text: Your friends dare you to stage a ridiculous prank in a supermarket and post it online. Someone is already holding a phone.

outcomes.film_viral: The clip hits a million views. Strangers recognise you at the supermarket.
outcomes.film_flop: Eleven likes, mostly from your cousin.
outcomes.film_sued: The "victim" has a lawyer and a very good memory. You settle.
